title: Long-Context Positional Encoding & KV Cache Scaling: RoPE vs. Dynamic NTK vs. YaRN vs. MLA Decoupled RoPE

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Unscaled Base RoPE or Linear Position Interpolation (PI, theta' = theta / s)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern for 16x context expansion (Linear PI crushes high-frequency local tokens)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Dynamic NTK-Aware RoPE Scaling (Base Frequency Scaling base' = base * s^(d/(d-2)))
tiers.recommended_scenario: Zero-finetune 2x-4x dynamic context extension in vLLM/SGLang

tiers.tier: Tier 3: YaRN / Llama-3 Piecewise Frequency Scaling + Attention Logit Temperature (mscale)
Tier 4 (Recommended): MLA Decoupled Shared RoPE (64-Dim k_R + 512-Dim Latent c_KV) + YaRN Temperature
tiers.recommended_scenario: Ultra-long 128K+ serving with 3.55x smaller KV Cache than GQA-8 & full matrix absorption
